title.text: Dubai Marina: Dinner Cruise with Live Music & Open Bar

pills.label: Open bar
pills.pop_html: What's poured: Unlimited beer, wine and spirits, plus unlimited soft drinks, juice, water, tea and coffee. A welcome drink is served as you board.

pills.label: Buffet + live stations
pills.pop_html: On the sample menu: Salads, Egyptian lentil soup, chicken cacciatore, grilled spice-rubbed fish, kadai vegetables, plus a live pasta station and a live noodle station. Red velvet and carrot cake for dessert.

pills.label: Glass boat, 2 decks
pills.pop_html: Seating: A glass-enclosed lower deck with panoramic windows and an open-air upper deck for the breeze and photos.

pills.label: Marina to Harbour
pills.pop_html: Route: Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence, Ain Dubai and Dubai Harbour, back at the dock around 10:00 PM.

best_for.pick_html: for couples and groups who want drinks included, because it is the only dinner cruise here where unlimited beer, wine and spirits come with the €52 fare
best_for.skip_html: if you want the Burj Khalifa in view (this is a Marina route) or a seated served dinner rather than a buffet

items.a: 90-minute cruise, international buffet dinner with live stations, unlimited beer, wine and spirits, unlimited soft drinks, juice, water, tea and coffee.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Xclusive Yachts boarding point, Dubai Marina.
From €52 per person. The final price for your date is shown before you pay.
Back at the dock around 10:00 PM.

price.note: The price depends on the date and the option you pick. Final price shown before you pay.

title.text: Dubai: Luxury Canal Dinner Cruise with Optional Transfers

pills.label: Burj Khalifa route
pills.pop_html: What you pass: Dubai Festival City, Al Jaddaf, Mohammed bin Rashid Library, Dubai Creek Harbour, Burj Khalifa, Business Bay, JW Marriott Marquis and under the Dubai Canal Waterfall Bridge.

pills.label: Glass-enclosed dhow
pills.pop_html: Boat: A traditional dhow shape with a glass-encased deck, so you get the heritage look and dine indoors behind the glass.

pills.label: 5-star buffet
pills.pop_html: On the table: Arabic appetisers, grilled meat, fresh salads and Arabian sweets with live stations, after a welcome kahwah (Arabic coffee), dates and chilled refreshments.

pills.label: Saxophone + music
pills.pop_html: Entertainment: Arabic music and a saxophone performance. Entertainment is paused during the holy month of Ramadan.

best_for.pick_html: for first-timers who want the Burj Khalifa and Downtown skyline from the water, because it is the only route here that runs through Business Bay instead of the Marina
best_for.skip_html: if you want drinks included (alcohol is an optional extra) or you are visiting during Ramadan, when the entertainment is paused

items.a: Canal cruise, welcome kahwah, dates and refreshments, international buffet with live stations, entertainment, pickup and drop-off if option chosen.
Beer, wine, cocktails and spirits (optional, extra fee).
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Al Faris Floating Restaurant, Dubai Festival City (or hotel pickup if chosen).
English, Hindi, Arabic.

price.note: The price depends on the date and the option you pick. Final price shown before you pay.

title.text: Dubai Marina: Michelin Chef Menu Dinner Cruise & Live Show

pills.label: Set menu, seated
pills.pop_html: How dinner works: A multi-course menu created by a Michelin-starred chef, served at your table instead of a buffet queue.

pills.label: 8:00–10:00 PM
pills.pop_html: Timing: One fixed evening sailing of 2 hours through Dubai Marina, from Dubai Harbour Yacht Club.

pills.label: Live singer
pills.pop_html: Entertainment: A live singer and on-board entertainment. Free Wi-Fi and toilets on board.

pills.label: Bar extra
pills.pop_html: Drinks: Unlimited soft drinks, water, coffee and tea included. A full licensed bar is on board, alcohol paid on board.

best_for.pick_html: for anniversaries, birthdays and couples who care more about the food than the price, because it is the only cruise here with a seated, chef-designed multi-course menu
best_for.skip_html: if you want alcohol in the fare (it is paid at the bar) or you are prone to seasickness (it is flagged as unsuitable)

items.a: 2-hour yacht cruise, multi-course dinner from a Michelin-chef menu, live singer, unlimited soft drinks, water, coffee and tea, Wi-Fi.
Alcohol (paid at the onboard bar), hotel transfer, special decorations.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Dubai Harbour Yacht Club, Boat Parking A19.

price.note: The price depends on the date and the option you pick. Final price shown before you pay.

title.text: Dubai: Canal Cruise with Dinner & La Perle Show (Gold Tickets)

pills.label: La Perle Gold Pass
pills.pop_html: The show: A Gold Pass for La Perle by Dragone, the acrobatic water show (about 1.5 hours). The cruise drops you at La Perle, where the evening ends.

pills.label: Boards 6:15 PM
pills.pop_html: Timing: Boarding at 6:15 PM, departure 7:00 PM from Al Faris Floating Restaurant behind InterContinental Dubai Festival City.

pills.label: Buffet on a dhow
pills.pop_html: Dinner: International buffet on a luxury dhow with glass-enclosed and al fresco seating, plus recorded commentary. Confirmed al fresco seats cost 50 AED extra.

pills.label: Transfer option
pills.pop_html: Getting there: Pickup and return shared transfer if you choose that option, valid for hotels within 20 km of the venue.

best_for.pick_html: for anyone who has La Perle on their list anyway, because one booking covers the canal dinner, the Gold Pass and the drop-off at the theatre
best_for.skip_html: if you are travelling with children under 2 (not suitable) or just want a relaxed dinner without a show to rush to

items.a: Canal cruise with recorded commentary, international buffet, La Perle Gold Pass, pickup and return shared transfer if option selected.
House beverages unless option selected, photo souvenirs, confirmed al fresco seating (50 AED).
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Al Faris Floating Restaurant, behind InterContinental Hotel DFC, Dubai Festival City (parking at Festival City Mall North, P1).
Boarding 6:15 PM, departure 7:00 PM.

price.note: The price depends on the date and the option you pick. Final price shown before you pay.

title.text: Dubai Marina: Luxury Dinner Cruise with Buffet and Live Entertainment

pills.label: Tanura + DJ
pills.pop_html: Show line-up: A traditional Tanura dance, live music, a live DJ and a Darbuka drum show.

pills.label: Copthorne buffet
pills.pop_html: Dinner: International buffet by Copthorne Hotel (Millennium Hotels): salads, BBQ, hot mains, vegetarian dishes and desserts.

pills.label: Soft drinks only
pills.pop_html: Drinks: Welcome drinks, unlimited water, soft drinks, tea and coffee. Mocktail, milkshake or ice cream on selected packages. No alcohol listed.

pills.label: Modern catamaran
pills.pop_html: Boat: Air-conditioned lower deck or open-air upper deck, chosen when you book. Wheelchair accessible, clean restrooms on board.

best_for.pick_html: for families with kids and alcohol-free groups, because it has the fullest show (Tanura, live music, DJ, Darbuka) on a modern boat for €41
best_for.skip_html: if you want an open bar, or a quiet romantic dinner (the DJ and drum show make it lively)

items.a: 2-hour cruise, welcome drinks, international buffet (veg and non-veg), unlimited water, soft drinks, tea and coffee, live shows and music.
Hotel pickup and drop-off (extra, book 6 hours ahead), souvenir photo.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Dubai Marina (or hotel pickup at extra cost).
Arabic, English, French, Hindi, Tagalog.

price.note: The price depends on the date and the option you pick. Final price shown before you pay.

title.text: Dubai: Dhow Dinner Cruise on Creek or Marina with Live Shows

pills.label: Creek or Marina
pills.pop_html: Route options: The base option sails Dubai Creek, the old trading waterway. The Dubai Marina option costs extra.

pills.label: Wooden dhow
pills.pop_html: Boat: A traditional Arabian wooden dhow with traditional décor. Small-group option available.

pills.label: Buffet + veg
pills.pop_html: Dinner: Local and international buffet with vegetarian options, plus tea, coffee, sweets and fruit. Alcohol not included.

pills.label: Pickup option
pills.pop_html: Getting there: Hotel pickup and drop-off if you choose that option, with an English-speaking driver. Otherwise meet at the dock.

best_for.pick_html: for travellers who specifically want the old-Dubai Creek dhow with a hotel pickup for about €30, because it is the only Creek option here
best_for.skip_html: if you want a polished evening: it is rated 3.8, the lowest here, and alcohol is not included

items.a: Creek or Marina cruise by option, buffet dinner with vegetarian options, tea and coffee, sweets, fruit, live entertainment shows, hotel pickup and drop-off if selected.
Alcoholic drinks.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Depends on option (Creek or Marina dock, or hotel pickup).
English (driver).

title.text: Dubai: Scenic Dhow Cruise with Buffet Dinner and Live Shows

pills.label: From €22
pills.pop_html: Price: Down from €27, about €14 per hour on the water, the cheapest dinner cruise on this page by €8.

pills.label: Tanoura + puppets
pills.pop_html: Show: Live music, Tanoura dance and a live puppet show on board.

pills.label: 45-min dinner
pills.pop_html: Timing: The 1.5-hour sailing gives the buffet a 45-minute window. Starts and ends at Dream Sea Lounge.

pills.label: Dubai Harbour
pills.pop_html: Meeting point: Dream Sea Lounge, Dubai Harbour Yacht Club, Berth AA05. No hotel transfer included.

best_for.pick_html: for backpackers and budget travellers who want a Tanoura show and a buffet on a wooden dhow for €22, and are fine with a basic boat
best_for.skip_html: if dinner is the main event or you want drinks included: it is rated 3.9, alcohol is not part of the package and there is no transfer

items.a: Dhow cruise, buffet dinner, live entertainment.
Alcoholic drinks, tips.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Dream Sea Lounge, Dubai Harbour Yacht Club, Berth AA05.
English (host).
